comment: Versioned strategy parameters. Every assessment stores a hash of this file so Phase 3 can answer 'which thresholds produced this verdict?'. Change values via git commits, never ad hoc.

ingestion.comment: pump.fun raw launches (~tens of thousands/day) are recorded but not snapshotted/filtered — graduation to PumpSwap is the quality gate that earns the full treatment. Flip a source between lists to change policy.

snapshots.comment: Decaying cadence: dense where the action is (first minutes), sparse later. `schedule` drives price/liquidity, which come from one batched Jupiter request covering every tracked mint and cost no RPC credits. `chainStateAtSec` (authorities + concentration, 2 RPC calls) and `holdersAtSec` (1 DAS call) are per-mint and metered, so they only refresh at these ages and are carried forward in between with their real observation timestamps. Both start at 0 so the assessment at t=0 has every field. Horizon cut 3600 -> 1800 on 2026-08-16: at ~110 new tokens/hour the old cadence implied ~9.3M RPC calls/month against a 1M/month allowance.
